rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an honest person and for a candid, straightforward statement.

example.english: To be honest, I really don't know.
example.jyutping: lou5 sat6 gong2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 zi1

rows.note: Choose this more formal word when explicitly describing truthfulness in a person, answer, or statement.

example.english: I’ll be honest and answer you: I really don’t know about this.
example.traditional: 我會誠實咁答你，呢件事我真係唔知。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 sing4 sat6 gam3 daap3 nei5 ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 zi1

rows.note: Use this for the fair and unbiased aspect of an honest account or description.

example.english: Give an honest and objective account, and don't take anyone's side.
example.traditional: 你客觀啲講，唔好偏幫任何人。
example.jyutping: nei5 haak3 gun1 di1 gong2 m4 hou2 pin1 bong1 jam6 ho4 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a mistake or action that was unintentional and not malicious.

example.english: Tearing your book was an honest mistake; I really didn't mean to.
example.traditional: 我真係無心整爛你本書㗎。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou4 sam1 zing2 laan6 nei5 bun2 syu1 gaa3
